from pathlib import Path
import ast
program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The three adjacent colors in the top row each trace a vertical ray.
    # If that color occurs elsewhere, turn at its row and connect to that cell.
    top = next(r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] for c in range(w)))
    cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[top]) if v]
    for c in cols:
        color = grid[top][c]
        points = [(r, x) for r in range(h) for x in range(w)
                  if grid[r][x] == color and (r, x) != (top, c)]
        if points:
            r, x = points[0]
            for y in range(min(top, r), max(top, r) + 1):
                out[y][c] = color
            for y in range(min(c, x), max(c, x) + 1):
                out[r][y] = color
        else:
            for y in range(top, h):
                out[y][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
